title: Gotrade Daily: AWS Roars Back, Microsoft's Record Day
summary: Amazon's AWS surged 37% and Microsoft posted a record day, lifting Wall Street. Tonight's watchlist: AMZN, MSFT, AAPL, NVDA, META.
body_markdown:
Amazon added fuel. AWS grew 37% year-on-year, its fastest in 18 quarters, and sales topped $200 billion. Tonight the market digests those reactions while awaiting Exxon and Chevron earnings.


## Tonight's Watchlist 📈


Stock Movement What to Watch


[AMZN](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amzn/) +9% after hours AWS grew 37%, sales topped $200B, and AI agents entering production are in focus


[MSFT](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/msft/) +16%, record day Azure the catalyst; the roughly $450B added is the largest one-day gain ever


[AAPL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/aapl/) -4% after hours Record iPhone sales (+22%), but weak guidance and supply worries drove a downgrade


[NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) Riding Asia's chip rally AI-memory demand from Samsung and SK Hynix and the global AI trade are the drivers


[META](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/meta/) Already reported this week Whether it joins the AI-cloud rebound and how its AI capex plan reads next


## Tonight's Catalysts 🧨


### AI cloud roars back: Microsoft's record, Amazon's AWS blowout


**Microsoft ([MSFT](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/msft/) )** surged about 16% and added roughly $450 billion in value, driven by Azure growth. **Amazon ([AMZN](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amzn/) )** followed with AWS up 37%, its fastest in 18 quarters, and sales past $200 billion. Together they reignited the case that the AI trade is far from over.


### Apple lags despite record iPhone sales


**Apple ([AAPL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/aapl/) )** moved the other way. iPhone sales rose 22% and results set a record, yet the stock fell more than 4% after hours on a weak forward forecast and supply-chain worries. At least one Wall Street firm cut its rating. It is the counterweight to the cloud optimism.
